Undergraduate Admissions 2027

Applications for the 2027 intake are now open. Example University welcomes applicants from all countries and offers more than forty undergraduate programmes in engineering, sciences and the humanities. Please read the requirements carefully before you apply.

Key dates

StageDeadline
Early round1 November 2026
Regular round15 January 2027
Scholarship applications1 December 2026

Who can apply

  • Applicants holding a secondary school certificate or equivalent
  • International students with IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90 and above
  • Transfer students with at least 30 credits completed elsewhere

Required documents

  • Certified transcript of records
  • Two letters of recommendation
  • Personal statement of up to 600 words

Tuition and fees

Tuition for international students is 14,500 EUR per academic year. The application fee is 75 EUR and is non-refundable. Merit scholarships covering up to 50% of tuition are available, see merit scholarships.

Ready? Start your application on the online application portal or read the admissions FAQ. Questions can be sent to admissions@example.edu.
